assumptions: CC INL absolute maximum 22.3 LSB (TI says characterized)
CC offset ±1 LSB (uncalibrated datasheet value, conservative after any unverified board calibration)
CC post-calibration drift 0.03 LSB/C times 35C from 25C to 60C
DNL 1 LSB engineering assumption; TI datasheet lists only ±0.1 LSB typical and TI FAQ recommends 1 LSB for a conservative calculation
CC2 code stability ±1 LSB at 3sigma used only as an explicit engineering reserve, not a hard maximum
measurement_error_model.important_limit: DNL 1 LSB and CC2 stability reserve 1 LSB are explicit conservative/model assumptions; the datasheet's 0.1 LSB DNL is typical and ±1 LSB stability is not a hard maximum. No installed board gain/offset readback or calibration is proven.

ccl.formula: I_CCL <= floor_q(min(I_request, max(0, K_min * (min(16A, I_cell_max(T)/alpha, I_OCC_early(Tshunt)-M_OCC) - I_os_bound) - E_underread)))
ccl.I_os_definition: I_os = total positive pack-current overshoot after an aggregate CCL change. Design acceptance is max(0,dI/dt)*local_response_delay + additional_peak_overshoot <= 1.0A across concurrent sources. The 1.0A bound is a conservative design budget to be verified at the local source loops; current source slew, local delay, and waveform are unknown.
ccl.conditional_case_interpretation: The former 10.5A cell/measurement-only command is not used. The executable reference algorithm takes the minimum of the 16A user ceiling, temperature-valid cell ceiling and OCC early-corner planning boundary, then subtracts the worst-case dynamic overshoot and measurement underread. For alpha=1.0 fallback it also requires a qualified no-counterflow condition; otherwise it returns CCL=0. Cell temperature qualification requires all 36 cells covered by conservative minimum and maximum bounds.
ccl.reference_algorithm_status: Executable Python design reference only, not deployed firmware. CCL remains zero unless all required validity/readback/source-bound gates pass. The 1A dynamic term is a designed acceptance budget, not measured source behavior; release remains blocked until local source loops demonstrate it. Alpha=1 fallback requires qualified no-counterflow current; any validated alpha must bound worst branch current, including circulating-current effects. Temperature bounds cover all 36 cells.

occ.configuration_status: design candidate only; actual register write/readback not verified
occ.margin_status: engineering planning assumption; not a BQ specification or verified protection coordination margin
occ.normal_CCL_compatibility_rule: Keep predicted peak <= early trip corner - explicit engineering planning margin. Do not rely on delayed OCC trip as normal current regulation.
occ.interpretation: BQ76952 OCC is a threshold comparator plus programmed delay and autonomous CHG-FET trip when configured. Code 3 is only a design candidate, write/readback is unverified. It cannot regulate current and cannot guarantee a 16A ceiling.

bus_energy.interpretation: At CCL=0, energy must be handled by local source reduction/inhibit and/or a validated supercap DC/DC sink. The supercap is not added to the public-bus capacitance. Cases are parameterized screens, not measured source latency or installed sink capability.

cell_and_pack.manufacturer_rating_temperature_note: EVE 30P charge operating range is not a flat 4A-per-cell rating; the 4A maximum-charge test is at 25C. No verified current-versus-temperature curve is in the project evidence.
cell_and_pack.full_rate_outside_manufacturer_test_wind: UNVERIFIED; CCL=0 pending manufacturer temperature curve or pack qualification.
cell_and_pack.algorithm_temperature_rule: 4A/cell max-rate model only when qualified conservative lower and upper temperature bounds cover all 36 cells, satisfy lower<=upper, and each interval lies wholly in [23,27]C; CCL=0 for missing, stale, invalid, reversed, uncovered, or out-of-window bounds until curve/qualification evidence exists.
cell_and_pack.alpha_definition: 最大单支路电流 / pack净充电电流；均流上界工程假设 alpha<=1/3，仅用于参数化候选，不是已测事实或电芯厂家参数。
cell_and_pack.alpha_assumption_rationale: 临时工程假设将最重支路设为总电流的1/3，即理想四等分1/4的1.33倍（相对理想均流允许约33.3%支路偏差）。该比例无厂家依据、无实测，必须由各并联支路电流台架测试或可追溯阻抗/温度分析验证；未验证时不可作为16A认证依据。
cell_and_pack.qualification_statement: EVE 30P 4.0A is a manufacturer maximum-charge test at 25C, not an all-temperature rating. At ideal 4P balance 16A is exactly 4A/cell with zero branch-sharing margin; alpha<=1/3 is an unvalidated engineering assumption, not proof of 16A cell compliance.

fault_behavior.full_cell_or_near_voltage_limit: reduce CCL by cell voltage/SOC policy and taper to zero before configured cell-voltage protection; if COV fault, stop charge sources and allow configured BQ CHG-FET protection to act.
fault_behavior.low_temperature_below_candidate_window: CCL=0; stop/inhibit source charging; if UTC protection is enabled and configured, it is a separate CHG-FET hard protection, not normal regulation.
fault_behavior.invalid_stale_sensor_or_config: CCL=0; local sources ramp/disable with a verified local response. If the source fails, BQ OCC/COV/UTC protections are backup hard trips if enabled/read back. Route unabsorbed regen to a verified supercap DC/DC sink or command zero regen and use vehicle braking; do not assume supercap acceptance.
fault_behavior.recovery: require valid cell/current/temp/configuration readback, no active charge protection, cell voltage/SOC headroom, source capability freshness, and valid temperature continuously for 3s, then ramp source back up under the newly recomputed CCL.

reference_algorithm.fail_closed_policy: Any missing/invalid all-cell lower/upper temperature bound, voltage headroom, calibration/readback, source bound/freshness, shunt thermal bound or path bound returns CCL=0.
reference_algorithm.alpha_policy: Use a validated worst-branch share when qualified. Alpha=1.0 fallback requires a qualified no-counterflow condition; otherwise CCL=0.
reference_algorithm.temperature_policy: Require conservative lower and upper bounds covering all 36 cells, with every cell interval inside 23..27C; missing, invalid, NaN, reversed, stale, or out-of-range bounds return CCL=0.
reference_algorithm.dynamic_policy: Source current overshoot bound must be qualified and <=1.0A; design acceptance uses max(0,dI/dt)*local_response_delay + additional_peak_overshoot <=1.0A.
reference_algorithm.implementation_status: Python reference is executable and tested; firmware/source actuation remains unimplemented and unverified.
